long_biography.plain_text:
When Jöbstl assumed control of the family enterprise in 2008, he inherited a regional operation and a lineage stretching back four generations. He favoured flat hierarchies, quick decisions and a balance between ambitious growth and commercial realism. Those principles guided purchases of specialist furniture and European land-transport operations, adding scale and new markets.

Later stewardship shifted attention from dealmaking to integration and resilience. The group established its headquarters in Baar, returned to entirely private ownership and invested in e-commerce, automated supply-chain systems and greener transport. Today Jöbstl also serves as board chairman and holds directorships across affiliated companies in Austria, Germany and Britain. His continuing career therefore combines family succession with sustained responsibility for a complex cross-border network.
